source.note: Source-derived, not a packet capture. Fields follow ResponsesApiRequest and build_responses_request at the pinned commit: stream true, store false, tool_choice auto, include reasoning.encrypted_content, input items typed as messages, and the bundled models.json reasoning effort and verbosity. A non-lite model sends an empty tools array and parallel_tool_calls true. Responses Lite (gpt-5.6-sol) omits tools, sets parallel_tool_calls false, sets reasoning.context all_turns, and sends x-openai-internal-codex-responses-lite. Session telemetry a live CLI adds from its login (client_metadata, item ids, base instructions, and the built-in tool list) is not in this turn because the client request only supplies the user message. prompt_cache_key is the session id, which infer supplies. Re-record with cargo run --bin traffic-record.
